architectureSummary: A React + Mantine single-page portfolio with smooth-scrolling navigation across 7 main sections (Hero, About, Skills, Experience, Projects, Contact, Footer). Uses Mantine's layout, form, and data-display components with custom theme configuration for dark/light mode support. Content is centralized in siteContent.js, with reusable UI patterns extracted to common components. The experience emphasizes technical credibility through visual skill indicators, project showcases, and a structured timeline.

files.responsibility: Centralized structured content including personal bio, skills with proficiency levels, work experience timeline, project portfolio with screenshots and links, and navigation configuration
Mantine design token configuration with primary/secondary color palette, typography scales (Inter for headings, Fira Code for technical elements), spacing, shadows, and component default overrides
React context for managing dark/light mode state with localStorage persistence and system preference detection
Utility function for smooth scroll behavior to page sections with offset calculation for fixed navbar
Formats date ranges for experience entries (e.g., 'Jan 2020 - Present', '2018 - 2020')
Email validation regex and helper function for contact form input validation
Sticky navigation header with logo, section links, mobile hamburger menu, active section indicator, and theme toggle integration
Page footer with copyright, quick navigation links, social media icons, tech stack mention, and back-to-top functionality
Reusable animated skill proficiency bar using Mantine Progress with percentage display and label, supports staggered animation on scroll
Reusable project showcase card with image, title, description, technology tags, and action buttons for demo/GitHub links
Reusable social media link component with icons for LinkedIn, GitHub, email, and other professional profiles
Toggle button component for switching between light and dark themes with icon indicators
Primary hero area with professional headshot/avatar, name, title, tagline, primary and secondary CTA buttons with scroll indicator animation
Personal introduction section with professional photo, biography text, key highlights, and resume download button
Technical skills showcase with category tabs (Frontend, Backend, DevOps, Tools), skill bars with proficiency percentages and years of experience
Work experience timeline in reverse chronological order using Mantine Timeline, with company logos, expandable job details, and technology tags per role
Project gallery with filtering by technology tags, project cards in staggered grid layout, and modal/lightbox for detailed project views
Contact conversion section with client-side form (name, email, message), validation feedback, success/error notifications, and availability status display
Root application component composing all major page sections with Mantine provider, theme context wrapper, and smooth scroll navigation setup
